g.text: NOTIONAL CREW / CARGO SPACECRAFT – MULTI‑VIEW BLUEPRINT (1 px ≈ 0.1 m)
Consistent geometry in all views. Nominal overall length 50 m (500 px), body diameter 6 m (60 px).
Top, Side, Front, Rear, and Longitudinal Cutaway (Section A–A) with consistent dimensions.
Engines, propellant tanks, crew module, cockpit, airlocks, docking port, radiators, solar arrays, antennas, landing gear, cargo bay, avionics, life‑support shown and labeled.
Conceptual only; not for fabrication. Mass, thermal and structural margins not represented.
